```{r setup}
suppressMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(stringr)
  library(openxlsx)
  library(VennDiagram)
  library(grid)
  library(here)
})

##  set project paths and key inputs for dlpfc and habenula coloc summaries.
here::i_am(".git/HEAD")
source(here("code", "analysis", "15_eqtl_coloc", "table_utils.R"))
datadir <- here("processed-data", "eQTL")
refdir <- here("processed-data", "ref")
hb_root <- "/home/gpertea/work/R/Habenula_Pilot"

f_dlpfc <- file.path(datadir, "coloc", "coloc_abf_results.tsv.gz")
f_dlpfc_gated <- file.path(datadir, "coloc", "coloc_abf_results_gated.tsv.gz")
f_hb_source <- file.path(hb_root, "processed-data", "18_coloc", "supp_table.csv")
hb_gene_dir <- here("code", "analysis", "15_eqtl_coloc", "gene_lists")
f_hb_gene_list <- file.path(hb_gene_dir, "habenulaPilot_coloc.tsv")
f_dlpfc_donor <- file.path(refdir, "donor_meta.tsv.gz")
f_hb_coldata <- file.path(hb_root, "processed-data", "17_eQTL", "tensorQTL_input", "colData.csv")
f_sens_sum <- file.path(datadir, "coloc", "prior_sensitivity", "w500k_prior_sensitivity_summary.tsv.gz")
f_sens_gene <- file.path(datadir, "coloc", "prior_sensitivity", "w500k_prior_sensitivity_per_gene.tsv.gz")
f_sens_fail <- file.path(datadir, "coloc", "prior_sensitivity", "w500k_prior_sensitivity_fail_summary.tsv.gz")
f_sens_fail_table <- file.path(datadir, "coloc", "prior_sensitivity", "w500k_prior_sensitivity_fail_table.tsv.gz")

##  overlap table specs for reproducible slide-ready exports.
overlap_specs <- list(
  gene_variant = c("gene_symbol_key", "rsid_key"),
  gene_only = c("gene_symbol_key")
)
stopifnot(identical(sort(names(overlap_specs)), c("gene_only", "gene_variant")))

##  define output location for final comparison artifacts.
final_dir <- file.path(datadir, "coloc", "final")
if (!dir.exists(final_dir)) dir.create(final_dir, recursive = TRUE)
```

```{r concept-notes, eval=FALSE}
##  prior-sensitivity in coloc.abf means checking how stable posterior conclusions are when priors vary, especially p12.
##  this is recommended because posterior probabilities can shift under different prior beliefs about shared causality.
##  our base coloc run for dlpfc used fixed priors p1=1e-4, p2=1e-4, p12=1e-5 and then sensitivity varied p12 over a grid.
##  habenula used coloc.abf without explicit prior arguments, so coloc defaults were used (the same default values above).
##  dlpfc strategy differs by adding dual-window evaluation (500kb primary plus 1mb sensitivity) and a separate prior-sensitivity report.
##  habenula strategy centered on the primary coloc run and downstream strong filtering at pp.h4.abf > 0.8.
```

```{r helpers}
##  define small helper utilities for schema checks and robust aggregation.
partition_levels <- c(
  "spd_spg_hb", "spd_spg_only", "spd_hb_only", "spg_hb_only",
  "spd_only", "spg_only", "hb_only"
)

std_rsid_key <- function(x) {
  y <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))
  y[y == "" | is.na(y)] <- NA_character_
  y
}

add_overlap_key <- function(dt, key_fields, key_sep = "||") {
  d <- copy(dt)
  for (k in key_fields) {
    d <- d[!is.na(get(k)) & get(k) != ""]
  }
  d[, overlap_key := do.call(paste, c(.SD, sep = key_sep)), .SDcols = key_fields]
  d
}

collapse_set_rows <- function(dt, overlap_type, key_fields, set_name) {
  d <- add_overlap_key(dt, key_fields = key_fields)
  d[, .(
    overlap_type = overlap_type,
    gene_name = first_non_missing(gene_name),
    rsid = first_non_missing(rsid),
    source_set = set_name,
    contexts = uniq_concat(context_or_group),
    gene_name_list = uniq_concat(gene_name),
    rsid_list = uniq_concat(rsid)
  ), by = overlap_key]
}

collapse_annotation_rows <- function(dt, overlap_type, key_fields) {
  d <- add_overlap_key(dt, key_fields = key_fields)
  d[, .(
    overlap_type = overlap_type,
    gene_name = first_non_missing(gene_name),
    rsid = first_non_missing(rsid),
    source_set = uniq_concat(source_set),
    contexts = uniq_concat(context_or_group),
    gene_name_list = uniq_concat(gene_name),
    rsid_list = uniq_concat(rsid)
  ), by = overlap_key]
}

complete_partition_counts <- function(partitions_dt, overlap_type) {
  obs <- partitions_dt[, .N, by = partition_label]
  tmpl <- data.table(partition_label = partition_levels)
  out <- merge(tmpl, obs, by = "partition_label", all.x = TRUE)
  out[is.na(N), N := 0L]
  out[, overlap_type := overlap_type]
  setcolorder(out, c("overlap_type", "partition_label", "N"))
  out
}

partition_to_venn_counts <- function(part_dt) {
  x <- setNames(part_dt$N, part_dt$partition_label)
  get_n <- function(k) if (k %chin% names(x)) as.integer(x[[k]]) else 0L
  spd_spg_hb <- get_n("spd_spg_hb")
  spd_spg_only <- get_n("spd_spg_only")
  spd_hb_only <- get_n("spd_hb_only")
  spg_hb_only <- get_n("spg_hb_only")
  spd_only <- get_n("spd_only")
  spg_only <- get_n("spg_only")
  hb_only <- get_n("hb_only")
  list(
    area1 = spd_only + spd_spg_only + spd_hb_only + spd_spg_hb,
    area2 = spg_only + spd_spg_only + spg_hb_only + spd_spg_hb,
    area3 = hb_only + spd_hb_only + spg_hb_only + spd_spg_hb,
    n12 = spd_spg_only + spd_spg_hb,
    n13 = spd_hb_only + spd_spg_hb,
    n23 = spg_hb_only + spd_spg_hb,
    n123 = spd_spg_hb
  )
}

draw_venn_counts <- function(venn_counts, title_label, out_png = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(out_png)) {
    png(out_png, width = 1400, height = 1000, res = 140)
    on.exit(dev.off(), add = TRUE)
  }
  grid.newpage()
  vp <- VennDiagram::draw.triple.venn(
    area1 = venn_counts$area1,
    area2 = venn_counts$area2,
    area3 = venn_counts$area3,
    n12 = venn_counts$n12,
    n13 = venn_counts$n13,
    n23 = venn_counts$n23,
    n123 = venn_counts$n123,
    category = c("7 SpDs", "4 SPGs", "habenulaPilot"),
    fill = c("#8cc0de", "#6e9dc0", "#c2d17d"),
    cex = 1.1, cat.cex = 1.0, cat.pos = c(-20, 20, 180),
    euler.d = FALSE, scaled = FALSE, ind = FALSE
  )
  grid.draw(vp)
  grid.text(
    label = title_label,
    x = unit(0.5, "npc"), y = unit(0.98, "npc"),
    gp = gpar(fontsize = 11, fontface = "bold")
  )
}
```

```{r load-inputs}
##  load required dlpfc and habenula coloc tables and assert expected schema.
assert_file(f_dlpfc)
assert_file(f_dlpfc_gated)
assert_file(f_hb_source)
assert_file(f_dlpfc_donor)
assert_file(f_hb_coldata)

dlpfc <- fread(f_dlpfc)
dlpfc_gated <- fread(f_dlpfc_gated)
hb <- fread(f_hb_source)

##  cache compact habenula coloc table locally (gene_name + variant_id) when missing.
if (!dir.exists(hb_gene_dir)) dir.create(hb_gene_dir, recursive = TRUE)
if (!file.exists(f_hb_gene_list)) {
  hb_gene_list <- unique(hb[, .(
    gene_name = as.character(gene_symbol),
    variant_id = as.character(snp)
  )])
  hb_gene_list <- hb_gene_list[
    !is.na(gene_name) & gene_name != "" &
    !is.na(variant_id) & variant_id != ""
  ]
  setorder(hb_gene_list, gene_name, variant_id)
  fwrite(hb_gene_list, f_hb_gene_list, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE)
}
hb_gene_list <- fread(f_hb_gene_list)
assert_cols(hb_gene_list, c("gene_name", "variant_id"), "habenula cached gene list")

assert_cols(dlpfc, c("fid", "gene_name", "lead_snp", "rsid", "PP4", "ds"), "dlpfc coloc table")
assert_cols(dlpfc_gated, c("window", "ds", "fid", "gene_name", "cat_gated", "gate_pass", "gate_reason"), "dlpfc gated coloc table")
assert_cols(hb, c("gene", "gene_symbol", "snp", "snp_rs_id", "PP.H4.abf"), "habenula supp table")
```

```{r gated-pass-clean-export}
##  build pass-only cleaned coloc results and add binary gwas/dge/eqtl annotations for reporting.
f_eqtl_cis <- file.path(datadir, "tqtl_out", "cis_independent_FDR05_merged.xlsx")
f_eqtl_nom <- file.path(datadir, "tqtl_out", "nominal_BH05_merged.xlsx")
f_gwas_match <- file.path(refdir, "GWAS_SCZ_tqtl-matched.tab.gz")
assert_file(f_eqtl_cis)
assert_file(f_eqtl_nom)
assert_file(f_gwas_match)

gated_pass <- dlpfc_gated[gate_reason == "pass"]
assert_cols(
  gated_pass,
  c("ds", "fid", "gene_name", "lead_snp", "rsid", "nsnps", "PP3", "PP4", "PP34", "PP4_over_PP34", "cat_gated"),
  "gated pass coloc table"
)
gated_pass[, cat := as.character(cat_gated)]

##  gwas risk flag from harmonized gwas variants at p < 5e-8.

gwas_risk_set <- unique(gwas_match[p < 5e-8 & !is.na(variant_id), variant_id])
gated_pass <- apply_gwas_flag(gated_pass, variant_col = "lead_snp", gwas_variants = gwas_risk_set, out_col = "GWAS")

##  eqtl/eqtlnom flags by context + variant using merged canonical workbooks.
cis_merged <- as.data.table(read.xlsx(f_eqtl_cis, sheet = 1, detectDates = FALSE))
nom_merged <- as.data.table(read.xlsx(f_eqtl_nom, sheet = 1, detectDates = FALSE))

assert_cols(nom_merged, c("expression_context", "variant_id"), "nominal merged workbook")
cis_key <- unique(cis_merged[!is.na(expression_context) & !is.na(variant_id), .(
  ds = as.character(expression_context),
  lead_snp = as.character(variant_id)
)])
nom_key <- unique(nom_merged[!is.na(expression_context) & !is.na(variant_id), .(
  ds = as.character(expression_context),
  lead_snp = as.character(variant_id)
)])
gated_pass[, eQTL := 0L]
gated_pass[, eQTLnom := 0L]
gated_pass[cis_key, on = .(ds, lead_snp), eQTL := 1L]
gated_pass[nom_key, on = .(ds, lead_snp), eQTLnom := 1L]

##  dge flag by context + gene using layer-adjusted spd and context-specific spg files.
deg_sets <- load_deg_sets(contexts = default_eqtl_contexts, project_root = here(), rdsdir = here("processed-data", "rds"))
gated_pass <- apply_deg_flags(gated_pass, context_col = "ds", gene_col = "fid", deg_sets = deg_sets)

coloc_clean_pass <- gated_pass[, .(
  ds, fid, gene_name, lead_snp, rsid, nsnps,
  PP3, PP4, PP34, PP4_over_PP34, cat,
  GWAS, DGE, DGEp05, eQTL, eQTLnom
)]
setorder(coloc_clean_pass, ds, cat, -PP4, -PP34, fid)
validate_binary_cols(coloc_clean_pass, c("GWAS", "DGE", "DGEp05", "eQTL", "eQTLnom"), "coloc_clean_pass")
if (coloc_clean_pass[DGE == 1L & DGEp05 != 1L, .N] > 0L) stop("coloc_clean_pass has DGE==1 rows not present in DGEp05.")

f_coloc_clean_tsv <- file.path(final_dir, "coloc_abf_results_gated_pass_clean.tsv.gz")

coloc_clean_pass_xlsx <- rename_coloc_excel_cols(coloc_clean_pass)

  "expression_context", "ENSEMBL", "gene_name", "lead_snp", "rsid", "nsnps",

  "risk_SNP_GWAS", "SCZD_DGE_layer_adjusted", "SCZD_DGE_layer_adjusted_p05",
  "eQTL_independent", "eQTL_nominal"
))

wb <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(wb, "coloc_pass")
writeData(wb, "coloc_pass", coloc_clean_pass_xlsx)
```

```{r canonical-schema}
##  build canonical per-row schema so all downstream outputs have consistent annotation fields.
dlpfc_can <- dlpfc[, .(
  source_project = "DLPFC",
  source_set = fifelse(grepl("^spd", ds), "spd_union_input", "spg_union_input"),
  context_or_group = as.character(ds),
  group = fifelse(grepl("^spd", ds), "SpD", "SPG"),
  gene_id_raw = as.character(fid),
  gene_id_norm = normalize_gene_id(fid),
  gene_name = as.character(gene_name),
  variant_id = as.character(lead_snp),
  rsid = as.character(rsid),
  PP4 = as.numeric(PP4),
  cat = if ("cat" %chin% names(dlpfc)) as.character(cat) else NA_character_
)]
dlpfc_can[rsid == "", rsid := NA_character_]
dlpfc_can[, gene_symbol_key := std_symbol_key(gene_name)]
dlpfc_can[, rsid_key := std_rsid_key(rsid)]

hb_can <- hb[, .(
  source_project = "habenulaPilot",
  source_set = "habenula_input",
  context_or_group = "habenulaPilot",
  group = "habenulaPilot",
  gene_id_raw = as.character(gene),
  gene_id_norm = normalize_gene_id(gene),
  gene_name = as.character(gene_symbol),
  variant_id = as.character(snp),
  rsid = as.character(snp_rs_id),
  PP4 = as.numeric(`PP.H4.abf`)
)]
hb_can[rsid == "", rsid := NA_character_]
hb_can[, gene_symbol_key := std_symbol_key(gene_name)]
hb_can[, rsid_key := std_rsid_key(rsid)]
```

```{r strong-filter}
##  define strong coloc sets using pp4 > 0.8 for cross-study comparability.
strong_dlpfc <- dlpfc_can[PP4 > 0.8]
strong_hb <- hb_can[PP4 > 0.8]

##  check optional consistency between pp4 thresholding and existing cat labels in dlpfc.
if ("cat" %chin% names(strong_dlpfc)) {
  dlpfc_cat_check <- dlpfc_can[!is.na(cat), .(
    n = .N,
    n_pp4_strong = sum(PP4 > 0.8),
    n_cat_strong = sum(cat == "strong_coloc")
  )]
  dlpfc_cat_check
}

##  bind all strong rows to simplify multi-set annotation and symbol ambiguity diagnostics.
all_strong <- rbindlist(list(strong_dlpfc, strong_hb), fill = TRUE, use.names = TRUE)
```

```{r overlap-build-and-export}
##  construct spd, spg, and habenula overlap tables using two explicit overlap types.
overlap_results <- list()
partition_counts_all <- list()

spd_rows <- strong_dlpfc[group == "SpD"]
spg_rows <- strong_dlpfc[group == "SPG"]
hb_rows <- strong_hb

for (overlap_type in names(overlap_specs)) {
  key_fields <- overlap_specs[[overlap_type]]

  spd_set <- collapse_set_rows(spd_rows, overlap_type = overlap_type, key_fields = key_fields, set_name = "spd_union_input")
  spg_set <- collapse_set_rows(spg_rows, overlap_type = overlap_type, key_fields = key_fields, set_name = "spg_union_input")
  hb_set <- collapse_set_rows(hb_rows, overlap_type = overlap_type, key_fields = key_fields, set_name = "habenula_input")

  all_keys <- sort(unique(c(spd_set$overlap_key, spg_set$overlap_key, hb_set$overlap_key)))
  venn_core <- data.table(overlap_type = overlap_type, overlap_key = all_keys)
  venn_core[, in_spd := overlap_key %chin% spd_set$overlap_key]
  venn_core[, in_spg := overlap_key %chin% spg_set$overlap_key]
  venn_core[, in_hb := overlap_key %chin% hb_set$overlap_key]
  venn_core[, partition_label := fcase(
    in_spd & in_spg & in_hb, "spd_spg_hb",
    in_spd & in_spg & !in_hb, "spd_spg_only",
    in_spd & !in_spg & in_hb, "spd_hb_only",
    !in_spd & in_spg & in_hb, "spg_hb_only",
    in_spd & !in_spg & !in_hb, "spd_only",
    !in_spd & in_spg & !in_hb, "spg_only",
    !in_spd & !in_spg & in_hb, "hb_only",
    default = "none"
  )]

  ann <- collapse_annotation_rows(all_strong, overlap_type = overlap_type, key_fields = key_fields)
  overlap_table <- merge(venn_core, ann, by = c("overlap_type", "overlap_key"), all.x = TRUE)
  overlap_table[, partition_label := factor(partition_label, levels = partition_levels)]
  setorder(overlap_table, partition_label, overlap_key)

  overlap_table[, partition_label := as.character(partition_label)]
  overlap_table[, contexts := fifelse(is.na(contexts), "", contexts)]
  overlap_table[, gene_name := fifelse(is.na(gene_name), "", gene_name)]
  overlap_table[, rsid := fifelse(is.na(rsid), "", rsid)]
  overlap_table[, rsid_list := fifelse(is.na(rsid_list), "", rsid_list)]

  setcolorder(overlap_table, c(
    "overlap_type", "overlap_key", "partition_label",
    "in_spd", "in_spg", "in_hb",
    "gene_name", "rsid", "rsid_list", "contexts",
    "source_set", "gene_name_list"
  ))

  out_name <- if (overlap_type == "gene_variant") {
    "strong_coloc_overlap_table_gene_variant.tsv.gz"
  } else {
    "strong_coloc_overlap_table_gene_only.tsv.gz"
  }
  fwrite(overlap_table, file.path(final_dir, out_name), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE)

  group_counts <- data.table(
    overlap_type = overlap_type,
    source_set = c("spd_union_input", "spg_union_input", "habenula_input"),
    n_keys = c(uniqueN(spd_set$overlap_key), uniqueN(spg_set$overlap_key), uniqueN(hb_set$overlap_key))
  )

  pcounts <- complete_partition_counts(overlap_table, overlap_type = overlap_type)
  partition_counts_all[[overlap_type]] <- pcounts

  overlap_results[[overlap_type]] <- list(
    overlap_table = overlap_table,
    group_counts = group_counts,
    partition_counts = pcounts
  )
}

partition_counts_all <- rbindlist(partition_counts_all, fill = TRUE, use.names = TRUE)
f_part_counts <- file.path(final_dir, "strong_coloc_partition_counts_by_overlap_type.tsv.gz")
fwrite(partition_counts_all, f_part_counts, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE)
```

```{r validation-checks}
##  run basic validation checks on overlap outputs and required metadata presence.
for (overlap_type in names(overlap_specs)) {
  x <- overlap_results[[overlap_type]]$overlap_table
  stopifnot(nrow(x) > 0L)
  stopifnot(any(x$in_spd | x$in_spg | x$in_hb))
  stopifnot(uniqueN(x$overlap_key) == nrow(x))
}

##  enforce gene-variant key completeness and uniqueness.
gv <- overlap_results[["gene_variant"]]$overlap_table
stopifnot(gv[gene_name == "" | is.na(gene_name), .N] == 0L)
stopifnot(gv[rsid == "" | is.na(rsid), .N] == 0L)
stopifnot(uniqueN(gv$overlap_key) == nrow(gv))

##  expected gene-only partition counts for this analysis snapshot.
expected_gene_only <- data.table(
  partition_label = partition_levels,
  expected_N = c(1L, 4L, 0L, 0L, 10L, 2L, 15L)
)
observed_gene_only <- partition_counts_all[overlap_type == "gene_only", .(partition_label, N)]
chk <- merge(expected_gene_only, observed_gene_only, by = "partition_label", all.x = TRUE)
chk[is.na(N), N := 0L]
stopifnot(all(chk$expected_N == chk$N))
chk
```

```{r context-barplot}
##  summarize gated strong coloc genes by context and export a plot-ready table.
ctx_map <- c(
  spd01 = "SpD01-WMtz",
  spd02 = "SpD02-L3/4",
  spd03 = "SpD03-L6",
  spd04 = "SpD04-WM",
  spd05 = "SpD05-L5",
  spd06 = "SpD06-L2/3",
  spd07 = "SpD07-L1-M",
  neun = "Neun",
  neuropil = "Neuropil",
  pnn = "PNN",
  vasc = "Vasc"
)
ctx_levels <- names(ctx_map)
ctx_labels <- unname(ctx_map)

strong_gated <- dlpfc_gated[cat_gated == "strong_coloc", .(ds, fid, gene_name)]
ctx_summary <- strong_gated[, .(
  n_strong = uniqueN(fid),
  gene_list = paste(sort(unique(gene_name[!is.na(gene_name) & gene_name != ""])), collapse = ", ")
), by = ds]

ctx_summary <- data.table(ds = ctx_levels)[ctx_summary, on = "ds"]
ctx_summary[is.na(n_strong), n_strong := 0L]
ctx_summary[is.na(gene_list), gene_list := ""]
ctx_summary[, context_label := unname(ctx_map[ds])]
ctx_summary[is.na(context_label), context_label := ds]
ctx_summary[, context_label := factor(context_label, levels = rev(ctx_labels))]
ctx_summary[, gene_list_wrapped := fifelse(gene_list == "", "", str_wrap(gene_list, width = 44))]

f_ctx_strong <- file.path(final_dir, "strong_coloc_gated_by_context.tsv.gz")
fwrite(
  ctx_summary[, .(ds, context_label = as.character(context_label), n_strong, gene_list)],
  f_ctx_strong,
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE
)

ggplot(ctx_summary, aes(x = context_label, y = n_strong)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.4, fill = "#4f83b6") +
  geom_text(
    aes(y = n_strong + 0.08, label = ifelse(n_strong > 0, as.character(n_strong), "")),
    hjust = 0,
```

```{r cross-study-overlap-helpers}
##  helper utilities for membership summaries and venn input counts.
build_membership_table <- function(sets_named) {
  set_names <- names(sets_named)
  universe <- sort(unique(unlist(sets_named, use.names = FALSE)))
  out <- data.table(gene_name = universe)
  for (nm in set_names) {
    out[, (nm) := gene_name %chin% sets_named[[nm]]]
  }
  out[, combo_label := apply(.SD, 1, function(z) {
    present <- set_names[as.logical(z)]
    if (length(present) == 0L) "none" else paste(present, collapse = " & ")
  }), .SDcols = set_names]
  out
}

build_combo_template <- function(set_names) {
  bits <- as.data.table(expand.grid(rep(list(c(FALSE, TRUE)), length(set_names))))
  setnames(bits, set_names)
  bits[, combo_label := apply(.SD, 1, function(z) {
    present <- set_names[as.logical(z)]
    if (length(present) == 0L) "none" else paste(present, collapse = " & ")
  }), .SDcols = set_names]
  bits <- bits[combo_label != "none"]
  bits[, n_sets := rowSums(.SD), .SDcols = set_names]
  setorder(bits, n_sets, combo_label)
  bits
}

summarize_combos <- function(membership_dt, set_names) {
  tmpl <- build_combo_template(set_names)
  obs <- membership_dt[combo_label != "none", .(
    n_genes = .N,
    gene_list = paste(sort(unique(gene_name)), collapse = "; ")
  ), by = combo_label]
  out <- merge(tmpl, obs, by = "combo_label", all.x = TRUE)
  out[is.na(n_genes), n_genes := 0L]
  out[is.na(gene_list), gene_list := ""]
  setcolorder(out, c("combo_label", "n_sets", set_names, "n_genes", "gene_list"))
  setorder(out, -n_genes, -n_sets, combo_label)
  out
}

venn_counts_5way <- function(sets_named) {
  stopifnot(length(sets_named) == 5L)
  s1 <- sets_named[[1]]; s2 <- sets_named[[2]]; s3 <- sets_named[[3]]; s4 <- sets_named[[4]]; s5 <- sets_named[[5]]
  inter_n <- function(...) length(Reduce(intersect, list(...)))
  list(
    area1 = length(s1), area2 = length(s2), area3 = length(s3), area4 = length(s4), area5 = length(s5),
    n12 = inter_n(s1, s2), n13 = inter_n(s1, s3), n14 = inter_n(s1, s4), n15 = inter_n(s1, s5),
    n23 = inter_n(s2, s3), n24 = inter_n(s2, s4), n25 = inter_n(s2, s5),
    n34 = inter_n(s3, s4), n35 = inter_n(s3, s5), n45 = inter_n(s4, s5),
    n123 = inter_n(s1, s2, s3), n124 = inter_n(s1, s2, s4), n125 = inter_n(s1, s2, s5),
    n134 = inter_n(s1, s3, s4), n135 = inter_n(s1, s3, s5), n145 = inter_n(s1, s4, s5),
    n234 = inter_n(s2, s3, s4), n235 = inter_n(s2, s3, s5), n245 = inter_n(s2, s4, s5), n345 = inter_n(s3, s4, s5),
    n1234 = inter_n(s1, s2, s3, s4), n1235 = inter_n(s1, s2, s3, s5),
    n1245 = inter_n(s1, s2, s4, s5), n1345 = inter_n(s1, s3, s4, s5), n2345 = inter_n(s2, s3, s4, s5),
    n12345 = inter_n(s1, s2, s3, s4, s5)
  )
}

venn_counts_4way <- function(sets_named) {
  stopifnot(length(sets_named) == 4L)
  s1 <- sets_named[[1]]; s2 <- sets_named[[2]]; s3 <- sets_named[[3]]; s4 <- sets_named[[4]]
  inter_n <- function(...) length(Reduce(intersect, list(...)))
  list(
    area1 = length(s1), area2 = length(s2), area3 = length(s3), area4 = length(s4),
    n12 = inter_n(s1, s2), n13 = inter_n(s1, s3), n14 = inter_n(s1, s4),
    n23 = inter_n(s2, s3), n24 = inter_n(s2, s4), n34 = inter_n(s3, s4),
    n123 = inter_n(s1, s2, s3), n124 = inter_n(s1, s2, s4), n134 = inter_n(s1, s3, s4), n234 = inter_n(s2, s3, s4),
    n1234 = inter_n(s1, s2, s3, s4)
  )
}

validate_venn_counts_5way <- function(vc) {
  stopifnot(all(unlist(vc) == as.integer(unlist(vc))))
  stopifnot(vc$n12345 <= min(vc$n123, vc$n124, vc$n125, vc$n134, vc$n135, vc$n145, vc$n234, vc$n235, vc$n245, vc$n345))
  stopifnot(vc$n12 <= min(vc$area1, vc$area2))
  stopifnot(vc$n13 <= min(vc$area1, vc$area3))
  stopifnot(vc$n14 <= min(vc$area1, vc$area4))
  stopifnot(vc$n15 <= min(vc$area1, vc$area5))
  stopifnot(vc$n23 <= min(vc$area2, vc$area3))
  stopifnot(vc$n24 <= min(vc$area2, vc$area4))
  stopifnot(vc$n25 <= min(vc$area2, vc$area5))
  stopifnot(vc$n34 <= min(vc$area3, vc$area4))
  stopifnot(vc$n35 <= min(vc$area3, vc$area5))
  stopifnot(vc$n45 <= min(vc$area4, vc$area5))
}

validate_venn_counts_4way <- function(vc) {
  stopifnot(all(unlist(vc) == as.integer(unlist(vc))))
  stopifnot(vc$n1234 <= min(vc$n123, vc$n124, vc$n134, vc$n234))
  stopifnot(vc$n12 <= min(vc$area1, vc$area2))
  stopifnot(vc$n13 <= min(vc$area1, vc$area3))
  stopifnot(vc$n14 <= min(vc$area1, vc$area4))
  stopifnot(vc$n23 <= min(vc$area2, vc$area3))
  stopifnot(vc$n24 <= min(vc$area2, vc$area4))
  stopifnot(vc$n34 <= min(vc$area3, vc$area4))
}
```

```{r supplemental-prior-sensitivity}
##  load supplemental prior-sensitivity outputs if available and summarize strong-locus robustness.
if (file.exists(f_sens_sum) && file.exists(f_sens_gene)) {
  sens_sum <- fread(f_sens_sum)
  sens_gene <- fread(f_sens_gene)
  assert_cols(sens_gene, c("ds", "fid", "default_pass", "frac_pass", "min_pass_p12"), "prior sensitivity per-gene")

  strong_key <- unique(strong_dlpfc[, .(ds = context_or_group, fid = gene_id_raw)])
  sens_strong <- merge(
    strong_key,
    sens_gene,
    by = c("ds", "fid"),
    all.x = TRUE
  )
  sens_strong_summary <- sens_strong[, .(
    n_strong = .N,
    n_with_sensitivity = sum(!is.na(frac_pass)),
    n_default_pass = sum(default_pass == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_frac_pass = mean(frac_pass, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_any_pass_grid = sum(!is.na(min_pass_p12))
  ), by = ds][order(ds)]

  f_sens_strong <- file.path(final_dir, "strong_coloc_prior_sensitivity_summary.tsv.gz")
  fwrite(sens_strong_summary, f_sens_strong, sep = "\t")
  sens_strong_summary
} else {
  message("prior-sensitivity files not found; skipping supplemental panel.")
}
```

```{r supplemental-gate-failures}
##  load and summarize gate outcome reasons by category and context in a compact panel.
if (file.exists(f_sens_fail) && file.exists(f_sens_fail_table)) {
  sens_fail <- fread(f_sens_fail)
  sens_fail_table <- fread(f_sens_fail_table)
  fail_compact <- sens_fail[, .(n_loci = sum(n_loci)), by = .(cat_raw, gate_reason)][order(cat_raw, gate_reason)]

  f_fail_compact <- file.path(final_dir, "prior_sensitivity_gate_reason_counts.tsv.gz")
  f_fail_by_context <- file.path(final_dir, "prior_sensitivity_gate_reason_by_context.tsv.gz")
  fwrite(fail_compact, f_fail_compact, sep = "\t")
  fwrite(sens_fail_table, f_fail_by_context, sep = "\t")
  fail_compact
  sens_fail_table

  fail_plot <- copy(sens_fail_table)
  fail_plot[, ds := factor(ds, levels = sort(unique(ds)))]
  fail_plot[, cat_raw := factor(cat_raw, levels = c("strong_coloc", "likely_coloc", "distinct_causal", "follow_up"))]

  ggplot(fail_plot, aes(x = ds, y = n_loci, fill = gate_reason)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.75) +
    coord_flip() +
    facet_wrap(~ cat_raw, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      x = "context",
      y = "number of loci",
      title = "prior-sensitivity gate outcomes by context",
      subtitle = "mid-level summary by cat_raw and gate_reason"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
      pass = "#6aa84f",
      fail_default_rule = "#cc0000",
      fail_cat_instability = "#e69138",
      fail_no_plausible_points = "#8e7cc3",
      fail_sensitivity_error = "#999999",
      not_evaluated = "#c9c9c9"
    ))
} else {
  message("prior-sensitivity fail summary files not found; skipping gate-failure panel.")
}
```
